raw_response:
Ai, let me think about this year's cotton. I've been growing it for so many years, my hands know what to do before my head does.

I'm getting old now, 63 this year. My wife and I, that's all we have at home — the kids are out working. 7 mu of cotton isn't big but it's not small for two old people either. Cotton is hard work, especially the picking. That's the part that really tires me out these days.

**Seed:** I'll buy hybrid cotton seed from the agricultural supply shop in the township, same kind I've been using — the pest-resistant one (Bt cotton, they call it). Saves some spraying for bollworm. About 90 yuan per mu. I don't save my own seed for cotton, hybrid doesn't work that way.

**Planting:** Late April, around the 20th or so, once the soil warms up. If it's cold I wait a few more days. I'll plow the land in early April, make the ridges, then lay the plastic mulch and plant through it. Plastic mulch really helps cotton here, keeps the soil warm and moist.

**Fertilizer:** I use compound fertilizer (二铵, DAP) as base — about 40 kg per mu before planting, worked into the ridges. That gives me around 6-7 kg P and some N to start. Then I topdress urea at flowering (花铃期), maybe 20-25 kg of urea per mu, so that's another 10 kg N or so. Total N comes out to maybe 14-15 kg/mu. Cotton doesn't need too much N or it grows too much leaf and not enough bolls — my neighbor applied heavy urea two years ago and his cotton grew tall but the bolls were small. I also mix in some potassium chloride (氯化钾), maybe 10 kg per mu, because cotton needs potassium for the bolls. The extension guy mentioned this years ago and I've stuck with it.

**Irrigation:** I have the tube well, so I can water. But pumping costs money — electricity. I'll water twice: once around mid-June when it starts flowering (if no good rain), and again around late July when the bolls are filling. If the summer rains come, I skip one. Two irrigations is enough for cotton here — too much water makes the bolls rot.

**Pesticide:** This is the biggest headache with cotton. Even with Bt seed, I still spray for aphids (蚜虫) and the plant bugs (盲蝽). Probably 4-5 sprays through the season. Also one herbicide spray before planting to kill weeds, and maybe one more by hand hoeing mid-season. I buy the common stuff from the shop, whatever the boss recommends.

**Labor:** This is where I worry. Me and my wife can handle the planting, fertilizing, spraying — no problem. But the picking in September and October, three or four rounds as the bolls open — 7 mu is too much for two old people. I'll need to hire some help, maybe neighbors' wives who pick for daily wages. Maybe 20 days of hired labor total. Expensive but I have no choice. My back can't do what it used to.

**Yield:** Last year I got about 260 kg of seed cotton... no wait, I mean lint, about 250 kg/mu after ginning. That was a decent year. This year I'll hope for similar, maybe 250 kg lint per mu if weather cooperates. Cotton price has been okay, around 7 yuan per jin for seed cotton at the gin.
